title: Bronze Age
description: Early civilizations in Mesopotamia, Egypt, and the Indus Valley use bronze tools and writing.

title: Classical Greece
description: Flourishing of philosophy, democracy, art, and science in the Greek city-states.

title: Roman Republic
description: Rome expands across Italy and the Mediterranean under a republican government.

title: Roman Empire
description: Imperial Rome rules the Mediterranean world from Britain to Egypt.

title: Han Dynasty
description: China's first great imperial dynasty establishes Confucian statecraft and the Silk Road.

title: Middle Ages
description: Medieval Europe, feudal society, rise of Christianity and Islam, Crusades.

title: Islamic Golden Age
description: Scientific, medical, and philosophical advances across the Islamic world.

title: Mongol Empire
description: Largest contiguous land empire in history, linking East and West.

title: Renaissance
description: Rebirth of classical learning, art, and humanism in Europe.

title: Age of Exploration
description: European voyages connect the Americas, Africa, and Asia.

title: Industrial Revolution
description: Mechanization, steam power, and factories transform society and economy.

title: Cold War
description: Ideological and geopolitical tension between the United States and the Soviet Union.
